name: flow
purpose: A few nodes and the arrows between them, left to right or as a loop, for example guess → compare → adjust.

nodes.doc: the nodes, each {"id": a short id, "text": at most 32 characters}

edges.doc: the arrows, each {"from": id, "to": id, "text": at most 3 words}; with no edges, each node points to the next

layout.doc: row: left to right; cycle: a loop

label.doc: a small label above the flow
